key_findings: At 2 weeks after SNL, 11 mPFC proteins (incl. 14-3-3 epsilon, Gαo, Rab-3A, Hsc71, metabolic enzymes) were upregulated >1.5-fold, whereas only 4 proteins were altered at 8 weeks.
Triosephosphate isomerase was the only mPFC protein persistently upregulated at both early and late timepoints, indicating time-dependent remodeling of the mPFC during pain chronification.
